items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: He was Rose Barbera. He was a daughter of Isidot Barbera. A member of the original Longwood Brass Band. And of that union, I was brought into this well against my will.

ctx.x: Now where did you say he came from, Ball?

Ball came from Kentucky. Kentucky. It's a mystery to me how he came down south. He was going north. I think he was employed on one of the river boats. He settled in New Iberia. That's why I met my grandmother. He was born with four children. He moved in the Walther. And he worked as a stevedo, a long shaman on the river front. He read his children to tell the gun he came of age. He was not a twin, since my father met my mother. He was Rose Barbera. He was a daughter of Isidot Barbera. A member of the original…
New York's a nice people sort of town, isn't it?
